notes: Clear Up Space no longer freezes the whole launcher ('Not Responding'): the storage scan is now fully async with real-time progress (files counted + current directory) instead of blocking the main thread and sitting at '0 files'. Duplicate mods in Installed are now healed permanently on disk (real case: Better Block Entities listed twice) — the dedupe used to collapse in-memory only and re-appeared on restart, now any reconciliation is persisted. External links (CurseForge/Modrinth descriptions, Report issues / View source / Discord) now always open in the system browser with a will-navigate safety net — no more being stranded on an external page inside the launcher with no back button.
